## Game 7 of the 2025 NBA Finals — June 22, 2025

According to the ESPN scoreboard for June 22, 2025, the **Oklahoma City Thunder defeated the Indiana Pacers 103–91** to win Game 7 and claim the NBA championship. [1]

| Detail | Info |
|---|---|
| **Matchup** | Indiana Pacers @ Oklahoma City Thunder |
| **Final Score** | **OKC 103** – IND 91 |
| **Winner** | Oklahoma City Thunder 🏆 |
| **Status** | Final |
| **Event ID** | 401766128 |

The Thunder closed out the series at home, securing the franchise's first NBA title (since the Seattle SuperSonics era) with a 12-point victory in the decisive Game 7.
